51da94d6-a215-4f69-b569-c45bc1557d02.title: Max Missile Launcher
51da94d6-a215-4f69-b569-c45bc1557d02.description:
By MaxZ666
launch missile
#2ce6e6 light_blue #cfcfcf-input : identify #19e753Missile (Green)
#d02525 red        #cfcfcf-input : save missile (any color)
#0a3ee2 dark_blue  #cfcfcf-input : recycle broken missile
#7514ed purple     #cfcfcf-input : launch timed missile (10s)
#eeeeee white      #cfcfcf-input : switch to next target
#222222 black      #cfcfcf-input : switch to last target
#e2db13 generateMissile    #cfcfcf-input : #df6100launch missile!
#7514edpurple can show CD
